headline: Bitcoin ETFs Record $643 Million in Outflows Following Binance Hack
summary: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds experienced $643 million in outflows on Friday, marking the largest outflow since June 25 following a Binance hack.
why: Spot Bitcoin ETFs provide institutional and retail investors with regulated exposure to cryptocurrency prices without direct asset custody, making fund flows a key indicator of market sentiment.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Substantial ETF outflows reduce demand pressure for the underlying cryptocurrency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Large outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs indicate a sharp withdrawal of capital by institutional and retail fund investors, weighing directly on market liquidity and sentiment.
